events.factual_description: Birdland Theater presents Senri Oe Trio for four sets across Friday, October 30 and Saturday, October 31, 2026, at 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM each night. The official Birdland page identifies Senri Oe on piano and compositions, Matt Clohesy on bass, and Ross Pederson on drums, and frames the engagement around Oe's latest album HOMEWORK. Birdland states that HOMEWORK receives its worldwide release on September 4, 2026 and that it was recorded at The Bunker Studio with Clohesy and Pederson. Sony's official Otonano portal documents the Japanese album release on June 24, 2026, while Oe's official publishing channel states that the worldwide digital/CD release is September 4. Birdland lists a current ticket range of $35.46-$45.76 for each set.

en.why_it_matters: This is a particularly clean Japan-to-New-York thread: Oe did not simply carry a Japanese pop career into a jazz room; he rebuilt himself as a jazz pianist in New York and now brings the trio behind HOMEWORK into Birdland at the moment the record is reaching a worldwide audience. Clohesy and Pederson are the album rhythm section, so the live proposition is the working trio rather than a pickup band around a release date. The interest is in how Oe's melodic instincts and long pop-writing history behave inside an acoustic trio built for interaction.
en.trip_verdict: If a New York trip overlaps October 30-31, actively make room for one of the four Birdland sets and let it anchor that part of the evening. From the DMV, pair it with another strong New York reason rather than make a dedicated corridor trip solely for this engagement.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí el hilo Japón–Nueva York está especialmente bien armado: Oe no llegó a un club de jazz simplemente cargando una carrera de pop japonés; se rehízo como pianista de jazz en Nueva York y ahora lleva a Birdland al mismo trío que grabó HOMEWORK justo cuando el disco sale al mundo. Clohesy y Pederson son la sección rítmica del álbum, así que no es una banda armada para acompañar un lanzamiento sino un trío que ya tiene lenguaje propio. Lo interesante es escuchar qué ocurre cuando el instinto melódico y la larga historia de Oe como compositor pop entran en una formación acústica que vive de la interacción.
es.trip_verdict: Si una ida a Nueva York cae el 30 o 31 de octubre, sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los cuatro sets y dejaría que Birdland ancle esa parte de la noche. Desde el DMV, lo combinaría con otra razón fuerte para subir en vez de hacer el viaje regional únicamente por esta fecha.
